common.serverDown: Awaaz se connect nahi ho pa raha. Server chalu ho raha hai, ek minute lag sakta hai.
common.couldNotSave: Save nahi ho paya. Phir se koshish karein.

login.headline: Un logo ke liye phone calls jo sun ya bol nahi sakte.
login.subhead: Aap likhein aur Awaaz aapki jagah bolega. Samne wala jo bolega wo likha hua dikhega, daam aur time ke saath.
login.footnote: Har call ke shuru mein Awaaz samne wale ko batata hai ki ek assistant help kar raha hai.
login.signInHint: Call karne aur uthane ke liye sign in karein.
login.createHint: Bas ek minute lagta hai. Iske baad aap chunein ki aap kaise baat karenge aur sunenge.
login.devUser: Dev user ki tarah aage badhein (sirf local)
login.accountCreated: Account ban gaya. Email par aaya link check karein aur confirm karke sign in karein.
login.resetSent: Agar is email ka account hai, toh humne password reset karne ka link bhej diya hai.
login.typeEmailFirst: Pehle upar apna email likhein, phir “Password bhool gaye?” dabayein.

authErrors.notConfirmed: Pehle apna email confirm karein. Link ke liye inbox check karein.
authErrors.exists: Is email par pehle se account hai. Sign in karne ki koshish karein.
authErrors.shortPassword: Kam se kam 6 akshar ka password banayein.
authErrors.tooMany: Bahut baar koshish ho gayi. Kuch minute ruk kar phir koshish karein.
authErrors.badEmail: Yeh email address sahi nahi lag raha hai.
authErrors.googleOff: Google sign-in abhi chalu nahi hai.
authErrors.generic: Kuch galti ho gayi. Phir se koshish karein.

onboarding.languageHint: Awaaz har jagah iska istemaal karega. Aap ise kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.
onboarding.title: Aaiye aapki calls ki setting karein
onboarding.hint: Do chhote sawaal. Aap baad mein Main section mein sab badal sakte hain.
onboarding.nameLabel: Hum aapko kis naam se bulayein?
onboarding.nameHint: Har call ke shuru mein samne wale ko yeh naam bataya jayega.
onboarding.howPhone: Aap phone ka istemaal kaise karte hain?
onboarding.fineTuneHint: Koi bhi tarika chunein. Baat karne ka pehla tarika calls par default rahega.

home.title: Calls
home.noCallsBody: Call shuru karein, ya niche practice call karke dekhein ki likha hua text aur jawab kaise kaam karte hain.
home.practiceHint: Nakli call, asli phone call nahi hai
home.newCallHint: Wo number dalein jise call karna hai. Awaaz unhein batayega ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyBody: Jin logon ko aap baar baar call karte hain unka number save karein. Note jodein, jaise “meri BP ki dawai Telma 40 hai”, aur Awaaz iska jawab mein use kar sakta hai.
contacts.sheetHint: Jawab sujhane ke liye Awaaz in notes ka istemaal kar sakta hai.
contacts.name: Naam
contacts.notesPlaceholder: Jaise: meri BP ki dawai Telma 40 hai
contacts.saveFailed: Save nahi ho paya. Number check karein.
contacts.deleteBody: Isse yeh contact aur iske notes hat jayenge. Purani calls aapki history mein rahengi.

me.title: Main
me.nameHint: Har call ke shuru mein samne wale ko bataya jayega.
me.phrasesHint: Call par jaldi bolne wali baatein
me.signedInAs: {{email}} ke naam se signed in hain

profile.startFromHint: Yeh bas ek basic setting hai. Aap niche sab kuch badal sakte hain.
profile.howTalkHint: Jo bhi aap use karte hain sab chunein. Pehla waala aapka main tarika hoga.
profile.howHear: Main unki baat kaise sunta hoon
profile.howHearHint: Koi bhi jod sakte hain, jaise likha hua text aur saaf aawaz ek saath.
profile.disclosure: Samne wale ko batayein ki assistant help kar raha hai
profile.summary: Aap bolte hain: {{talk}}{{also}}. Aap sunte hain: {{hear}}.

presets.deafspeak: Sun nahi sakta, par bol sakta hoon
presets.deaftype: Sun nahi sakta, likhna pasand hai

voice.title: Aap bolein, Awaaz bolega
voice.hint: Main mic mein bolunga. Awaaz har waakya call par bolega aur mujhe dikhayega.

replies.title: Tay waakya aur smart jawab
replies.hint: Ek baar dabane par jawab chala jayega.

help.title: Bolne mein meri madad karein
help.hint: Thode se shabd likhein, poora saaf waakya ban jayega. Pehle main check karunga.

clear.title: Mujhe bol kar sunayein
clear.hint: Samne wale ki har baat dheere aur poori aawaz mein padh kar sunayi jayegi.

summary.title: Call ke baad ki summary
summary.hint: Kya baat hui, number ke saath, jise main padh ya sun sakta hoon.

vibe.title: Vibration ka ishara
vibe.hint: Samne wale ke bolne aur rukne par phone vibrate hoga.

translate.title: Mere liye translate karein
translate.hint: Wo chahe kisi bhi bhasha mein bolein, meri bhasha mein padhein aur likhein.

phrases.title: Mere tay waakya
phrases.emptyTitle: Abhi koi tay waakya nahi hai
phrases.emptyBody: Jab tak aap apna waakya nahi jodte, call screen par kuch bane-banaye waakya dikhenge.

history.nothingSaid: Is call par koi baat nahi hui.
history.loadFailed: Yeh call load nahi ho payi.

call.reconnecting: Phir se connect ho raha hai…
call.draftTitle: Aapke liye banaya gaya. Bole jaane se pehle check karein
call.draftUnclear: Aapke shabd thode ulajh gaye the. Check karein ki kya aap yahi kehna chahte hain.
call.previewTitle: Bole jaane se pehle check karein
call.helpPlaceholder: Thode shabd likhein, main poora waakya bana doonga
call.phrasesHint: Bolne ke liye ek baar dabayein.
call.keypadHint: Phone menu ke liye number dabayein, jaise “1 dabayein…”.

blocked.scam_digits: Nahi bheja gaya: Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN ke number nahi bolega.
blocked.empty: Bhejne ke liye kuch nahi hai.
blocked.too_long: Message bahut bada hai. Kripya ise chhota karein.

call.micDenied: Live voice ke liye microphone ki permission dein.
call.voiceListening: Sun raha hai. Aap bolein, Awaaz kahega.
call.voiceFailed: Live voice abhi kaam nahi kar raha hai. Aap likh kar baat kar sakte hain.

otp_request.title: Unhone aapka OTP maanga hai
otp_request.body: Bank kabhi bhi call par OTP nahi maangte. Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN padh kar nahi sunayega.

pin_request.title: Unhone aapka PIN maanga hai
pin_request.body: Kisi bhi bank ya dukaan ko call par aapke PIN ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padh kar nahi sunayega.

upi_pin.title: Unhone aapka UPI PIN maanga hai
upi_pin.body: Aapka UPI PIN sirf aapke liye hai. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padh kar nahi sunayega.

cvv_request.title: Unhone aapke card ka CVV maanga hai
cvv_request.body: Call par kabhi bhi CVV mat batayein. Awaaz is call par card ki details padh kar nahi sunayega.

remote_app.title: Unhone aapko app install karne ko kaha
remote_app.body: Kisi ke kehne par kabhi bhi app install mat karein. Isse wo aapka phone aur bank account dekh sakte hain.

other.title: Yeh ek nakli ya scam call ho sakti hai
other.body: Saavdhan rahein. Awaaz is call par OTP, PIN ya card ki details padh kar nahi sunayega.

errors.draft_failed: Yeh waakya nahi ban paya. Dusre shabd use karke dekhein.
errors.not_available: Bolne mein madad ke liye live AI service chahiye.
errors.unknown_preview: Ab confirm karne ke liye kuch nahi hai.
errors.bad_event: Kuch galti ho gayi. Phir se koshish karein.
